title: Harness canvas worker draws architecture diagrams in chat
summary: @mfpiccolo had the coding harness build a canvas worker so agents draw architecture diagrams directly in chat and via a console-injectable UI instead of screenshotting from external diagramming tools.
question_it_answers: How can a coding harness render architecture diagrams in-chat without external screenshot paste?

claims.text: Author built a harness canvas worker so the agent draws diagrams in chat rather than pasting screenshots.
claims.evidence: I asked my harness to build itself a canvas worker. Now the agent draws the diagram right in the chat
claims.subject: infographics-diagrams

claims.text: The worker also exposes a console-injectable UI for viewing the rendered diagram outside the transcript.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

media.description: Attached demo video showing the harness canvas worker rendering an architecture diagram inside the chat UI.
